train_LabelSpreading_active_learning: train a LabelSpreading model iteratively with active learning on the digits dataset
compute_prediction_uncertainty: compute the entropy of label distributions to find the most uncertain predictions from LabelSpreading
select_most_uncertain_samples: select the top 5 most uncertain unlabeled samples for active learning labeling
evaluate_LabelSpreading_model: evaluate a fitted LabelSpreading model using classification report and confusion matrix
load_digits_dataset: load the scikit-learn digits dataset and prepare a shuffled subset for semi-supervised learning
